stages.summary: Play Chapter 1 and the start of Chapter 2. Do the one thing that can never be redone: the balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1. Scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars whenever you see something new — the counts carry into the 100% checklist.
stages.title: Step 1 — Chapters 1–2: first steps

stages.summary: Finish the story through Chapters 3, 4 and 5. All chapter and mission trophies pop as you play; none can be missed. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together, which the partner trophies need. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay.
stages.title: Step 2 — Chapters 3–5: finish the story

stages.summary: With the story done, work the character questlines and the strangers. Andy (Lucia only, Chapter 3), Kenton (Key Lento), Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub), Randy (16 sports cars) and Tyrone (Jason only) each end in a trophy, and Bret's hunting questline ends in one too. Then finish any 8 counting Strangers & Freaks strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count. Cal's fishing challenge also lives here.
stages.title: Step 3 — Character quests & strangers

stages.summary: The long open-world grind. Work the collectibles and activities: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), gold at all 42 shooting-range challenges, drone races at all 14 locations, 20 race wins, 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK scans at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, the whole map unfogged, and 50 of the 80 challenges. Most of these count double toward the 100% checklist.
stages.title: Step 4 — Collectibles, activities & the open world

stages.summary: Robberies, money and clean-up. Tail security vans to rob 5 bank vaults (8 for 100%), rob an armored truck and a jewelry store unseen, hit one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs, and steal the blue Banshee out of its showroom window. Launder $250,000 in marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles with Scooter Bros. Finish the 100% checklist for the gold, and the platinum follows.
stages.title: Step 5 — Robberies, money & the platinum
